raw_blocks: "At Par Pacific, we truly believe our people are our greatest asset. We demonstrate this by investing in them personally and professionally to ensure they feel supported and heard. Our core values of respect for others, integrity, collaborative innovation and heart are embedded in our daily activities and enable our employees to thrive."
-- Matthew Legg, Senior Vice President, Chief Human Resources Officer
We are a tight-knit company full of extraordinary individuals

Working at Par Pacific is vibrant and fun. Since we are a smaller energy company, employees can make a meaningful impact on the business and to influence decisions. People have amazing careers at Par because they are exposed to all areas of the company and work closely with industry experts.
Par Pacific operations are located in some of the most beautiful places in the country and our employees get to make these appealing places their home and enrich their lives.
Our Mission Captures Who We Are & Guides Us Toward Who We Want to Become

Our Mission, Humbly Serving Communities , is about people – our communities, our teams, and the purpose that binds us. Each word matters. We listen first, lead by lifting others, and we’re in this together in each of the communities that we serve.
Our values underscore our actions

Par Pacific is a values-driven company. Our tight-knit community values respect for others, integrity, collaborative innovation, and heart. These four pillars support our successes and strengthen our ability to be an effective and fun place to work.

We listen before we speak, yet understand action is needed for progress. We value the unique heritage, experiences, and contributions of everyone and everywhere we are blessed to work with and serve. It’s important, therefore, to keep our people safe and to protect the environment , as we pursue growth and success.

We know right from wrong , our behaviors are guided by our mission and core values , and our people are trusted . We expect our work to be conducted with the highest ethical standards to achieve our best results.

Creativity drives innovation and fuels the generation of new ideas . We understand creativity alone is not enough. It is through collaborative innovation that we bring those ideas to life ! Through our collaborative efforts and effective systems , these ideas become impactful results that open new worlds of opportunity.

An ounce of heart is worth more than a ton of intellect and talent. We care deeply about the communities in which we operate. We succeed when our hard work, grit and resilience is balanced with good rest. We root for each other, celebrate each other ’ s successes and learn from our mistakes.

raw_blocks: The commercial team is charged with the acquisition of crudes and feedstocks used in the refinery, as well as the ultimate sale of products produced by the Refinery. Products that are produced are listed below and identified with the Specification Sheets and corresponding Safety Data Sheet.

For over forty years, U.S. Oil has been a consistent supplier of high quality paving grade and emulsified asphalts to contractors in the Puget Sound region. Working with Federal, State and Local agencies, we have become a leader in the development of products designed to improve the quality of the area's highways and roads. U. S. Oil is also a key supplier of industrial grade asphalt to the roofing materials industry. Our industrial asphalt (Flux) is an integral component in the manufacture of high quality Asphalt Shingles, Rolled Goods and Coating Asphalts.
Typical crude oils we process include:
Bakken Blend crude | SDS
Alaska North Slope crude | SDS
Cold Lake Crude Blend | SDS
From our truck loading facility in Tacoma, U.S. Oil markets the full range of transportation fuels. Products available at our rack include:
Unleaded Clear and E10 Gasolines
Ultra Low Sulfur, and Premium Grade Ultra Low Sulfur Diesel Fuels and Bio Fuels
Dyed Ultra Low and Premium Grade Ultra Low for off-highway and Heating fuel uses

Since our entry into the marine fuels market in 1980, U. S. Oil has had the reputation of being a supplier of high quality fuels to the maritime industry. From our marine terminal located in Tacoma, WA, we are well situated to meet the increasing demands for marine fuels generated by the rapidly expanding port areas of Seattle and Tacoma. Our Marine Fuels Department is available on a 24 x 7 basis, working with our customers to ensure that their requirements are met on a timely and cost efficient basis. Through our continued commitment to Quality, Service and Performance U.S. Oil has earned its position as the premiere supplier of marine fuels in the Puget Sound. U.S. Oil has the capability to deliver into barges or vessels at our Tacoma dock.
PG 70 & 76 Grades
PG Grades for M332 (S,H,V,E)
General Terms for Exchange and Sale of Light Products
Marine Provisions for Delivery and Loading
New Customer Packet ASPHALT (Rack)
New Customer Packet ASPHALT (Rail)
New Customer Packet LP (Non-Carrier)
U.S. Oil & Refining Co.
1735 Port of Tacoma Road Tacoma, WA

Terminal has two docks. Dock #1 handles ships and barges. Dock #2 handles only barges. Oil products handled at this terminal are crude oil, gasoline, jet fuel, diesel, vacuum gas oil, and marine fuels. Contact Puget Sound Pilots, 206-728-6400, for specific port transit restrictions.
Maximum manifold height above MLLW:
Minimum parallel mid-body (flat side):
Dock #1 has mooring and fendering capacity for 125k DWT vessels. Draft, tankage and offloading rate combine at present to limit vessels larger than 70k DWT to less than full cargo.
Services: Marine Fuels available at 3000 B/hr. Fresh water available if ship provides hose. There are no facilities at this terminal for dirty ballast, slop reception or hazardous waste.
Dock #2 has mooring and fendering capacity for 16,700 MT vessels. Products that can loaded/unloaded at Dock #2: Jet, Fuel Oil, MDO, Cutter, Diesel.
